The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart illustrates government expenditures as a percentage of GDP for European countries.
The description omits the correct labeling of the horizontal axis ('% des BIP') and the vertical axis (country names).
The description does not mention the segmentation of bars into green (2021 expenditures) and blue (increase from 2021 to 2024), nor the black line indicating 1.5% above the 2021 reference value.
The description does not mention the legend explaining the color coding and the black line.

The description does not highlight the countries with the highest expenditures (Polen, Estland, Lettland) or the countries with the lowest expenditures (Italien, Belgien, Slowenien, Luxemburg, Spanien).
